source_caption:
Javier Bardem and Penélope Cruz play a divorced couple in 𝐕𝐢𝐜𝐤𝐲 𝐂𝐫𝐢𝐬𝐭𝐢𝐧𝐚 𝐁𝐚𝐫𝐜𝐞𝐥𝐨𝐧𝐚 (𝟐𝟎𝟎𝟖). Ironically, it was while making this film that the two began their real-life relationship, eventually marrying in July 2010.⁣
⁣
However, their story goes back much further. Bardem and Cruz first met on the set of her debut feature, Jamón Jamón (1992), when Cruz was just 16 years old.⁣

source_details.title: Vicky Cristina Barcelona
source_details.synopsis: Vicky Cristina Barcelona is a 2008 romantic comedy drama film written and directed by Woody Allen. The film stars Javier Bardem, Penélope Cruz, Rebecca Hall and Scarlett Johansson. The plot centers on two American women, Vicky and Cristina, who spend a summer in Barcelona, where they meet an artist, Juan Antonio, who is attracted to both of them, while still enamored with his mentally and emotionally unstable ex-wife, María Elena. The film was shot in Barcelona, Avilés, and Oviedo, and was Allen's fourth consecutive film shot outside the United States.
